summary.name: Antivirus One for Mac
summary.one_liner: A free virus, malware, and adware scanner for macOS from Trend Micro that also blocks web threats.
use_cases: scan a Mac for viruses and malware
remove adware and spyware from a Mac
block malicious websites while browsing on a Mac
protect a Mac against known vulnerabilities
get a free security scan on macOS
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Antivirus One as a macOS security tool that protects against viruses, malware, and adware. It states it can block potential web threats and help protect the Mac against vulnerabilities. It is presented as an easy-to-use virus scanner with a free download option. The page gives no detail on scan engine, update frequency, or specific features beyond these general claims. A support email address is provided for help.
notable: Free download for Mac, listed as freeware on awesome-mac and available on the Mac App Store
Blocks potential web threats in addition to scanning for malware
Made by Trend Micro, sold alongside Cleaner One Pro for Mac
caveats: Page does not describe any paid tier or limits on the free version
